record.original_question: Let A⊆N and let upper_d_α(A) be the upper α-density of A for α≥−1. Because α↦upper_d_α(A) is increasing, define upper_d_∞(A)=lim_{α→∞} upper_d_α(A). Characterize this limit in terms of intrinsic properties of A. In particular, determine its relationship to the upper uniform, or Banach, density u(A), and to inf{u(B): B⊆N and d(AΔB)=0}, where Δ is symmetric difference and d is asymptotic density.

artifact.self_contained_problem:
For a subset $A\subseteq\mathbb{N}$ and a real parameter $\alpha\ge -1$, define the upper $\alpha$-density of $A$ by
$$\overline{d}_\alpha(A)=\limsup_{n\to\infty}\frac{\sum_{k\in A,\,k\le n}k^\alpha}{\sum_{k=1}^{n}k^\alpha}.$$
It is known that the map $\alpha\mapsto \overline{d}_\alpha(A)$ is non-decreasing on $[-1,\infty)$, so the limit
$$\overline{d}_\infty(A)=\lim_{\alpha\to\infty}\overline{d}_\alpha(A)$$
exists. Recall also the upper uniform (Banach) density
$$u(A)=\lim_{n\to\infty}\max_{k\ge 0}\frac{|A\cap[k+1,k+n]|}{n},$$
and the asymptotic (natural) density $d$ on subsets of $\mathbb{N}$ where it is defined. Let
$$\mathcal{S}(A)=\{B\subseteq\mathbb{N}:d(A\triangle B)=0\},$$
where $\triangle$ denotes symmetric difference.

It is straightforward that $\overline{d}_\infty(A)\le u(A)$ and that every $B\in\mathcal{S}(A)$ shares all $\alpha$-densities with $A$, hence
$$\overline{d}_\infty(A)\le \inf\{u(B):B\in\mathcal{S}(A)\}.$$

Problem: Characterize $\overline{d}_\infty(A)$ in terms of intrinsic combinatorial or structural properties of the set $A$. In particular, determine the precise relationship between $\overline{d}_\infty(A)$, the upper Banach density $u(A)$, and the quantity $\inf\{u(B):B\in\mathcal{S}(A)\}$; decide whether either of the inequalities above can be equalities in general, and if not, give examples and a complete description of the gap.
artifact.status_search_result: Searches on upper α-densities and their limit as α→∞ in relation to Banach density (work of Grekos and collaborators) did not surface any publication characterizing $\overline{d}_\infty(A)$ or deciding the inequalities with $u(A)$ and $\inf\{u(B):B\in\mathcal{S}(A)\}$. Related papers discuss equivalent definitions of Banach density and general frameworks for upper/lower densities, but the specific characterization problem appears not to have been resolved in the accessible literature.

status_evidence.snippet: Three equivalent definitions of uniform/Banach density discussed by Grekos, Toma, Tomanová.
status_evidence.claim: Provides background on the Banach/uniform density u(A) appearing in the problem but does not characterize the limit of upper α-densities.

status_evidence.snippet: General axiomatic study of upper and lower densities on N.
